entities.summary: Sergey Konstantinovich Gandlevsky is a Russian poet, novelist, and essayist. He is recognized as a prominent contemporary Russian poet, known for his style combining classical poetic forms with modern themes. His works explore topics of memory, identity, and the human condition.
